Note

InsDel2a and 2c 89-type and 476-type extractions collapse to 83-type signature close to C_ID2. InsDel2b extractions have more insertions of a single T in long poly-T contexts, which is absent in C_ID2, as well as some single T deletions in stretches of 4 and 5 T’s, which are also absent C_ID2
